shots.shot_type_other: product render of the headset lens that zooms through into a fast montage of VR gameplay footage with one-word captions
shots.focal_element: The headset lens (text appears inside it), then single centred caption words over each game clip
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans-serif, bold/semibold, sentence case, normal tracking, white; 'Jump into' sits inside the lens in a smaller italic-looking weight; a third word after 'Jump into' is motion-blurred and unreadable. Font guess (low confidence): Meta's in-house sans.
shots.what_happens: Close-up of the white headset; camera pushes into the lens where 'Jump into' appears, a radial zoom blur carries through the lens into gameplay, then quick cuts (not split by the shot detector) between a red-tinted stylised game ('Deeper'), a first-person proton-pack style game ('Larger', which fades/slides in) and a dark amber dungeon game ('Richer'), one word per clip on the music beat.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a lens render up past the viewport with a radial-blur zoom-through into a video, then cut clips every ~1 s on the beat, each with one centred bold white word that fades in with a slight blur.

shots.focal_element: An ornate puzzle box on a table manipulated by translucent tracked hands, with a centred two-line caption
shots.typography: Same bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, white, centred two lines; words reveal sequentially (first 'Immersive games', then 'and', then 'experiences' fading in).
shots.what_happens: First-person VR footage of hand-tracking hands turning a carved puzzle box on a cluttered table while the caption builds word by word in the centre.
shots.build_rebuild: Over full-bleed gameplay video, reveal a centred two-line caption word by word with ~150 ms opacity-and-blur fades per word.

shots.focal_element: Avatar golf scenes with the caption building in the centre
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, white, single line; words fade in left to right ('Plus all' solid while 'your' is still faint).
shots.what_happens: A canyon mini-golf clip with a cartoon avatar swinging, then (an undetected cut within this shot) a night-time avatar golf range with a fiery ball trail; the caption 'Plus all your old favorites' builds word by word and persists across the cut.
shots.build_rebuild: Keep a word-by-word caption layer on top while cutting the underlying gameplay clip mid-reveal, so the text bridges two clips.

shots.focal_element: A glowing triangular light frame on a snowy mountain with debris exploding outward
shots.typography: Same bold white sans-serif caption, sentence case, held from the previous shot.
shots.what_happens: Very short clip (one sampled frame): a bright glowing triangle on a snowy summit with sparks and rock fragments flying, the caption held unchanged.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a high-energy VFX gameplay clip of ~0.7 s while keeping the same centred caption layer static.

shots.shot_type_other: gameplay footage that gives way to a curved video wall of game title tiles
shots.focal_element: The curved wall of game tiles with the centred caption and its changing number
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, white, centred single line; the number slot is motion-blurred while it rolls before resolving to '500+'.
shots.what_happens: The snowy-mountain explosion continues under 'Plus all your old favorites', then the frame becomes a curved wall of many gameplay tiles drifting, with 'From our library of ___ titles' whose number rolls (blurred) before settling on '500+'.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out a 5x6 grid of looping video tiles on a slightly curved (cylindrical) plane drifting sideways, and overlay a centred caption whose number slot runs a blurred rolling counter that lands on '500+'.

shots.focal_element: A person in an orange shirt wearing the headset, dancing/lunging in a sunlit bedroom
shots.typography: At the end a small, motion-blurred white sans-serif word ('Get', rest unreadable) appears on a dark blue-green gradient card.
shots.what_happens: Low-angle live-action lifestyle shot of a user playing a motion game in their bedroom with warm backlight; in the last half second it changes to a dark gradient card where text starts to blur in (the start of the closing sequence).
shots.build_rebuild: Play a ~1.5 s low-angle lifestyle clip, then cut/fade to a dark radial-gradient card and blur-in the first word of the next caption.
